transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, what brings me in is that I just can't keep my mind on a task long enough to finish it anymore, even when it's really important. 

I do computer support, and lately, I'll start tracing a client's network problem... and ten minutes later I realize I've reread the same log entries three times, and I still don't know what they actually say. It's just getting really hard to get my work done.
Have you been feeling down or depressed recently?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I get pretty frustrated with myself when I can't get my work done, but... no, I don't feel depressed or down. My mood is actually fine. It's really just the focus that's the problem.
Did you have trouble paying attention like this when you were a child?

Yeah, I did. My mother actually still jokes about it. She says that back in grade school, my report cards always said I was bright, but... well, that I never stayed in my seat. I guess I also blurted out answers a lot, and I was always losing my homework, even when I had actually finished it. So, yes, it goes pretty far back.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energized or high and needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never had a time where I felt unusually high or like I didn't need to sleep. My sleep is pretty normal, and my energy levels don't really spike like that. It's really just the constant struggle to focus and sit still that's been the issue.
Do these focus problems also cause trouble for you at home?

Honestly, I haven't really noticed it being a big problem at home. I mean, work is where it really hits me, since I have to sit at a desk and troubleshoot computer systems all day. But at home... I don't know, I haven't really thought about it. I don't think it causes much trouble there, or at least, I haven't noticed it if it does. It's mostly just work where I really feel the impact.
Outside of work, do you also have trouble focusing on everyday tasks?

No, not really. Like I mentioned a minute ago, I haven't really noticed it being an issue outside of my job. When it comes to just normal, everyday stuff... running errands or doing chores around the house... I guess I just get it done. It doesn't require the same kind of focus as staring at a screen trying to fix a server issue all day. So, no, I wouldn't say everyday tasks are a problem for me.
When you're trying to focus at work, do you find yourself feeling anxious?

No, I wouldn't say I feel anxious. It's more just... frustrating, I guess? I mean, I know what I need to do, I just can't seem to make my brain lock onto it. But it's not anxiety. I'm not sitting there worrying or feeling nervous about it. I just get restless because I can't stay focused on the troubleshooting.
